description: This file defines the CookieJarInterface, a PHP interface for managing HTTP cookies within the GuzzleHttp library. It specifies methods for handling cookies, including extracting cookies from responses, adding cookies to requests, removing cookies, and converting the jar to an array.

classes.name: CookieJarInterface
classes.description: Interface for a cookie jar in GuzzleHttp, defining methods for cookie management, extraction, addition, removal, and serialization.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Creates a new request with added cookie headers based on the cookies stored in the jar.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from an HTTP response and stores them in the cookie jar.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies from the jar, optionally filtered by domain, path, or name.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the cookie jar to an array representation.
